text:
The Israeli needs to go register the marriage because it is going onto their PIBA file. 

If the foreigner (or the couple) have permission to come to Israel to start the process, there is no requirement to start the process immediately on landing. Bu generally you don't want to delay it too much, as it just means that it will take longer for your partner to get their B1 visa. 

PIBA will extend your partner's B2 visa for as long as needed once you have a file open. If you haven't filed yet, it might be harder to convince them.
